fact: The 2025 Finance Law (Law 24-08 of 24 November 2024) exempts start-ups and incubators from property transfer duty on real estate acquisitions, extends incubators' IRG/IBS exemptions by two years on label renewal, and exempts registration duties for innovative-project label holders.
title: Algérie : les principales mesures importantes de la loi de Finances pour 2025
